fields.name: thread.current.id
fields.note: k_thread identity of the thread being switched in; the dispatcher passes the thread's numeric id, never its pointer

fields.name: thread.current.priority
fields.note: Zephyr priority of that thread; negative values are cooperative, so this field is sign-extended into the frame

fields.name: timestamp.cycles
fields.note: free-running cycle counter read by the dispatcher at hook entry, before the probe runs, so every field of one event shares one instant

attaches.name: thread.switched_in
attaches.note: Zephyr calls this from the scheduler with interrupts locked on the paths measured so far, so it is declared SCHED_LOCKED -- the stricter of the two plausible classes. Measuring it may allow relaxing to THREAD later, which is additive, and discovering the reverse would be a breaking change, which is why the strict class is the default

slot_states.name: EMPTY
slot_states.note: no blob; IVARS and code slot are zeroed

slot_states.name: STAGED
slot_states.note: blob written to staging, nothing validated yet

slot_states.name: READY
slot_states.note: manifest, capability binding and cost admitted

slot_states.name: QUIESCING
slot_states.note: dispatcher will not call it; calls already entered may run

slot_states.name: RECLAIMABLE
slot_states.note: ring drained and acknowledged; nothing left to read
